rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the coalition together with a narrow opinion reframing Hardison as fact-bound and clarifying that “undue hardship” requires a business-significant burden, not mere de minimis cost or coworker resentment. Alito likely dissents on stare decisis/reliance grounds, while Thomas/Gorsuch/Barrett (and possibly Kavanaugh) are the most likely to add concurrences pressing a more explicitly textual repudiation of the de minimis gloss.
